split_detail: Frozen train0..77, calibration80..121, untouched scoring126..249. No holdout refit or interval recalibration. Matured holdout outcomes feed safety veto only. Prior iteration2 holdout already viewed: this is a prespecified synthetic regression comparison, not a novel confirmatory holdout.
maturity: signal i entry open i+1 exit open i+2 available close i+3; require i+2<decision clock
method: Training cell date means clipped at +/-5%; 5-date block standard errors. Partial pooling two pseudo dates toward adjacent-cell smooth parent with full shrinkage displacement penalty. Independent calibration estimates block residual bias and scale, never mean. Radius=abs(calibration residual mean)+2.58*hypot(train blockSE,calibration blockSE)+shrink displacement. Gaussian conditional-mean ordinal posterior using same conservative scale; full interval within economic band and posterior >=.95. Identifiable spread lower confidence bound >.003. Frozen fit. Separate safety monitor uses high-minus-low cell date contrast, nonoverlapping 5-date holdout blocks, union-bound 1% two-sided Gaussian threshold across26 looks; calibration variance and baseline uncertainty included, hard minimum shift .004. Alarm latches UNKNOWN permanently; no relearning. Gaussian/block stability assumptions explicit, not distribution-free certification.
sensors: EXACT iteration2 generate; identical features, prices, truth scoring and seeds. iteration2 repaired comparator uses iteration2.predict on same fine sensors, EV baseline unchanged.
pass_rule: For every non-null scenario/seed: coverage>=.5, each predicted tier>=20, conditional latent-tier accuracy>=.7, each recall including UNKNOWN>=.5, false GREAT on true TERRIBLE<=.01, all five realized means strictly monotone. Null safety requires zero assigned. Robust overall claim requires every seed. Improvement additionally requires paired non-null coverage increase and no reversal false-GREAT rate increase versus iteration2 repaired comparator. No portfolio gain alone constitutes discrimination.
risk: 10% position targets only; entire cost-inclusive modeled candidate risk<=2%; inherited corrected local kernel, T+1 and MDD latch; no GA or production modifications
limitations: Synthetic regression tapes previously evaluated in iteration2: untouched means no fit/update with holdout outcomes in iteration3, not fresh confirmatory data.
Five-date block independence and approximately Gaussian date-block means assumed; finite sample robust coverage is not guaranteed.
Posterior is over conditional mean bands, not individual latent class; no oracle labels in fit.
A shock before matured outcomes cannot be predicted by a safety alarm.
Calibration uncertainty may honestly preclude middle tiers; no thresholds relaxed.
Synthetic sensor information is injected; no real-market alpha claim.
One-session net labels differ from multi-session portfolio holdings; no terminal liquidation.
